title: Close the policy-vehicles policy-number oracle
story: As a carrier I want the claimant vehicle picker to reveal vehicles only to the policy's own holder so that a claimant cannot probe arbitrary policy numbers
acceptance: GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles returns vehicles only when the session's claimant is the policy holder (match the claimant identity on the session against the policy snapshot's named insured/holder via the coverage service, not by trusting body fields); CSR and agent roles keep their current behaviour

An unknown policy number and a real policy that is not the caller's return the identical response (same status, same body, no vehicle data), so the endpoint is no longer an oracle; test asserts deep equality of the two responses
Timing is not a separate oracle: no early return that skips the policy lookup for unknown numbers (comment explains)
tests/unit/intake/policy-vehicles-holder.test.js covers holder, non-holder, unknown policy, other tenant; existing policy-vehicles tests still pass
Demo path unchanged: tests/e2e/demo-script.test.mjs passes; no edits under tests/security (post the new behaviour to the security hub for S5-SEC-01)
brief: Finding: docs/cots-readiness.md 'policy-vehicles policy-number oracle'. Route at src/modules/intake/routes.js, logic around src/modules/intake/service.js:324. Look at how claimant identity is represented on sessions and tokens (src/core/auth.mjs dev users, data/dev-users.json from scripts/seed.mjs) and how coverage exposes the policy holder (ctx.modules.coverage). If the session has no verifiable claimant identity, return the uniform not-found response. Do not edit questions.js (S5-WFL-02) or conversation.js (S5-AI-01). If openapi needs a change post a contract-change to the architecture hub (S5-ARC-01 owns openapi.yaml).
